environment.description: Application deployed on ECS Fargate behind an ALB with two rule evaluation stages. The ALB target group health check path is /healthz. The AWS WAFv2 WebACL (arn:aws:wafv2:us-east-1:XXXX:regional/webacl/hr-app-acl) is associated with the ALB and contains the following rule groups evaluated in priority order: (1) Priority 0: AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesCommonRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK action, (2) Priority 1: AWS managed rule group AWSManagedRulesSQLiRuleSet with all rules in BLOCK action including body/query-string/URI inspection with sensitivity level HIGH, (3) Priority 2: Custom rate-limiting rule at 100 requests per 5 minutes per source IP. Additionally, the ALB access logs are shipped to CloudWatch with a metric filter alarm on 403 responses. The ECS task role has no network egress except to the RDS endpoint (but the app still uses local SQLite as shown). The VPC has no NAT gateway or internet gateway on the task subnet — only a VPC endpoint for ECR and CloudWatch.

config.load_balancer: AWS ALB with WAFv2 WebACL association
config.network: private subnet, no IGW, no NAT, VPC endpoints only (ECR, CloudWatch, S3)
config.egress_security_group: outbound only to 10.0.3.0/24:5432 (RDS subnet) and VPC endpoints
